name: Sinew Brace
description: Draw the will into the tendons and brace so a heavy blow finds the frame locked and unmoving.

name: Willed Fist
description: Strike with a fist whose every muscle is driven by a single fixed purpose.

name: Body Gauge
description: Gauge the limits of the body against the limits of the will and learn which is nearer to failing.

name: Heartbound Step
description: Take a step in which the heartbeat and the footfall land as one and the body does not stagger.

name: Flesh Mending
description: Draw the numbness of shock and the poison of fear from the flesh of an ally with a slow warm pass of will.

name: Willed Blow
description: Throw a heavy blow in which body and will are one so that the arm does not tire before the purpose does.

name: Marrow Lend
description: Lend an ally the deep stubborn strength of the user's bones until the ally's own marrow answers.

name: Sinew Ward
description: Hold a ward of drawn sinew and will round the user that does not slacken under long pressure.

name: Resolve Frame
description: Turn the whole body into a frame of resolve that carries the weight of a collapsing hall without bending.

name: Heartbound Drive
description: Drive the whole will-bound body forward in a blow that carries the weight of every muscle at once.

name: Bone Return
description: Take a mighty blow through the bone into the will and send it back through the same bone as a single stroke.

name: Unbroken Body
description: streams: Heart + Body; fuse the will into every fibre of the flesh so that the body shrugs off a blow that would kill and strikes back with the weight of a falling pillar.

name: Windpipe Brace
description: Brace on the held breath and let the lungs and will together take a blow in the middle of the chest.

name: Pulse Fist
description: Strike on the surge of the qi pulse with the will pressing the pulse home.

name: Reserve Weigh
description: Gauge how much qi lies in reserve and how much of it the will can still call.

name: Flowing Pace
description: Move on the rhythm of the breath so that qi and stride never fall out of step.

name: Qi Settling
description: Settle the roiling qi of an ally in a bad deviation with the quiet pressure of the user's will.

name: Kindled Blow
description: Strike with qi kindled by will into a hot bright head that spreads at the point of contact.

name: Reserve Lend
description: Lend an ally part of the user's qi reserve and bind it to the ally with the user's resolve.

name: Flow Ward
description: Hold a ward of flowing qi shaped and held by an unmoving will.

name: Channel Surge
description: Pour the whole of the circulating qi through a single willed channel and out of the fist.

name: Resolute Flow
description: Keep a steady willed stream of qi running into an ally so the ally never runs dry.

name: Heartfed Mantle
description: Wrap the user and the nearest allies in a mantle of qi fed continuously by the will behind it.

name: Reserve Recoil
description: Gather the force of a hostile blow into the qi reserve and release it through the will as one hard return.

name: Heartfire Current
description: streams: Heart + Qi; run the heart stream through every channel of the qi at once until each breath of power burns with the whole will and the river of fire breaks through the foe's guard.

name: Inner Brace
description: Brace from the inside with the spirit settled behind the will so a shock lands on a stable core.

name: Inner Fist
description: Strike with a fist guided from within by a spirit that has already chosen the mark.

name: Spirit Gauge
description: Gauge how settled the spirit of a person is beneath the surface calm.

name: Inner Pace
description: Cross the ground with a quiet spirit and a body that follows without a sound.

name: Spirit Mending
description: Ease the erosion of a bruised spirit in an ally with a steady supporting pressure of will.

name: Inner Blow
description: Strike with the weight of will and spirit together so the foe feels the blow within as well as without.

name: Spirit Lend
description: Lend a failing ally a portion of the user's settled spirit to steady the ally's own.

name: Inner Ward
description: Hold a ward made of both will and spirit that guards the body and the mind at once.

name: Inner Surge
description: Surge forward with will and spirit moving as one and strike a blow that falls on both flesh and nerve.

name: Spirit Rousing
description: Call a stunned spirit back into an ally whose breath has just stopped by binding the ally's spirit to the user's will; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Inner Mantle
description: Throw a mantle of will and spirit round the nearest allies that shelters body and mind alike.

name: Spirit Recoil
description: Take a crushing blow into will and spirit together and send it back on a single answering stroke.

name: Heartsoul Unity
description: streams: Heart + Soul; fold the will into the spirit so that the user fights as one undivided being whose every blow lands on the body and the spirit of the foe.

name: Soulbound Resolve
description: streams: Heart + Soul; bind the spirit to the will so tightly that the user cannot be bowed by any force that acts on the mind alone and answers it in kind.
